paragraphs: Batti ben Tavi: included only to explain his identity, not a sage. Avodah Zarah 39. Heilprin infers from Rashi that Batti was Jewish. Tosafot treats him as an enslaved Canaanite who had yet to receive his writ of freedom, at the end of Avodah Zarah 76b. See the incident with Mar Yehudah before King Shapur; Asarah Yuchasin 70b; Jerusalem Gittin 1:6: pride kept him from taking a writ of freedom.
